page.title: Home page banners
page.hint: There's no limit on how many you create; the home page shows them all in order from top to bottom, but at most {max} banners may overlap in display time. Each screen size takes one image at the right ratio: desktop {desktop} · tablet {tablet} · mobile {mobile} (or @2x) — images at the wrong ratio are blocked on upload.
page.composition: Banners carry their own message — the home page puts no text over the image. Only the desktop image ({desktop}) has the search card over roughly its bottom third, so keep text and subject in the upper part.
page.empty: No top banners yet — the home page is showing the default strip
page.promoHint: Promo banners sit in the middle of the home page, right after "Featured cars". Create as many as you like, but at most {max} banners can show at the same time. Desktop image {desktop} (required) · mobile image {mobile} (optional) — a wrong ratio is blocked at upload.
page.promoComposition: Text, price and artwork live inside the image — the home page puts nothing on top. Desktop and tablet show two banners per row; mobile swipes one at a time. With no promo banner currently showing, the section is hidden from the home page.
page.emptyPromo: No promo banners yet — the promo section is hidden on the home page

actions.deleteConfirm: Delete this banner? The images stay in storage, so it can be recreated from the old URLs.

toast.capacityExceeded: Not saved: at most {max} banners can be shown at the same time. Turn off or reschedule another banner first.

form.intro: Create a responsive image set for the home page top banner strip. Banners carry their own message and show in full when the ratio is right; only the desktop image has the search card over its lower part.

basic.title: Internal details
basic.description: Helps the operations team recognise the campaign.

media.title: Responsive images
media.description: Use @2x files for sharp images. If tablet or mobile is left empty, the next larger image is used.

content.title: Content and link
content.description: The image description supports accessibility; the link decides where a click on the banner goes.

visibility.title: Schedule and status
visibility.description: Leave the schedule empty if the banner should show right away with no time limit.

title.label: Banner name
title.help: Only admins see this; it never appears on the home page.

altText.label: Image description (alt)
altText.placeholder: e.g. List your car easily with XePrime
altText.help: Screen readers read this text aloud.

linkUrl.label: Link on click
linkUrl.help: Optional. Accepts an internal path or a full URL.

active.description: Turn off to hide the banner from the home page without deleting it.

errors.linkInvalid: Only http(s) URLs or internal paths starting with / are accepted
errors.endBeforeStart: The end time must be after the start time

form.introPromo: Create a promo banner for the middle of the home page. Text and artwork live inside the image; desktop and tablet show two banners per row, mobile swipes one at a time.
form.mediaDescriptionPromo: Use the exact size or larger for a sharp image. Leave mobile empty to show the desktop image.

media.desktopComposition: The home search card covers roughly the bottom third of the desktop image — keep text and subject in the upper part.

errors.unreadable: Couldn't read the image file — it may be corrupted
errors.ratio: The {slot, select, desktop {desktop} tablet {tablet} other {mobile}} image must have a {size} ratio (this one is {actual}). Export it at that size or @2x ({size2x}).

media.promoComposition: Shown in full on desktop and tablet — nothing covers the image.
